description: The declared MCP server composition of this stack. `npm run check:mcp-servers` validates this declaration against the servers this repository ships; with --host-config it also compares it with what the host actually runs (same servers, same commands, pinned revisions, no duplicate tool names).

engineering-skills.role: The engineering provider: GitHub, workspace, repo/change/verify and spec tools. This repository's main MCP surface.

engineering-checklists.role: The local, opt-in checklist surface: checklist preparation, bounded CI wait and the remote serverless-agent runner.

search-skills.role: Web search: free (keyless) SERP and Serper. The canonical search server — the `trained` remote publishes the same tool names and would shadow them.

web-navigation.role: Reading side of the browser stack: open (with Cloudflare/JS-challenge handling), find, state, text, ask, screenshot.

safe-playwright.role: Interaction side of the browser stack: live UI actions (navigate, snapshot, click, type, wait, login) with credentials filled from the audited store instead of the model context.

zerocreds.role: The credential store: connections, credentials, forms and the audit trail behind every other server.

js-ts-code.role: JavaScript/TypeScript code writer with syntax validation and type checking.

cloudflare.role: Cloudflare API access: Workers, R2, D1, DNS, Zero Trust.

trained.role: Integration-test harness of the MCP host (profile integration-telegram-ux-v1). Disabled: it publishes search_serp_free and search_serper — the same names as search-skills — so one of the two is picked by start order, not by intent.
